items.result: Original single-pose Orbit Keeper, Void Drifter and Iron Circuit assets restored byte-for-byte from their original source crops; sprite rotation restored. Movement/abilities and existing gameplay tuning retained.
Shared facing ticks and redundant weapon aiming dots removed.
Pilot and crawler physical bounds now meet HEIGHT=480; local crawler drawing aligns alpha feet. Both floor and platform contacts retain their proper body radii.

A mirrored 0.22s overhead sweep hits each enemy once and pushes surviving targets 28px through geometry with a 95px/s impulse. Throw/retrieve mechanics persist; dropped-sword arrow removed. The ordinary-input QA recovery route completes deck descents.
Removed all in-arena control instruction prose at Pak draw sites. Resource meters/numeric nectar and menu/footer help remain.
Obstacles return zero damage and remain indestructible.

Existing sprite rendered as an 84x24 paddle, flush on all four edges. A Pak-owned rectangular contact footprint lets outer-span ball returns work. Original firing assistance retained; border reflections use perpendicular normals.
No forced clear center row. Seeded exit height and short east/west stubs join a connected braided maze; actual geometry drives route/wrap queries.
No attack cues or emergence windup; underground phase transitions immediately to the committed rush.
Base contact damage 32 plus level scaling; drift, 0.25-0.45s pause, then a random-heading 0.4s dart at 3.8x speed.
Targets scatter within +/-95x28px of player; three spread shots, five from level eight. Formation interval reduced to 1.75s before scaling.
Normal/ferry hops grant no invulnerability. Pilot protection circle omitted; existing post-hit and arrival safety remain separate.
Damage is 8+112*growth**2.4; radius 28+70*growth, capped at 98. Cascade reach radius+20. Nectar funding and capacity-only upgrades remain.
